subject.title: refactor(agents): retire TOOLS.md into an AGENTS.md section with a doctor migration

question: Should OpenClaw formally retire workspace `TOOLS.md` and accept `openclaw doctor --fix` as the single upgrade path that moves local notes and policy tool evidence into `AGENTS.md`?
rationale: This is an intentional user-workspace and governed-policy contract change, not a mechanical defect that review automation can decide solely from passing tests.

options.title: Accept the canonical migration
options.body: Merge with `AGENTS.md` as the sole runtime tool-notes source and Doctor as the one-time migration owner.

options.title: Keep a separate workspace file
options.body: Retain `TOOLS.md` as a supported bootstrap and policy source, abandoning this retirement until a different product model is approved.

options.title: Split the governed-policy transition
options.body: Land the workspace-note migration separately while deferring policy evidence URI changes to a dedicated compatibility proposal.

recommendation.title: Accept the canonical migration
recommendation.body: Merge with `AGENTS.md` as the sole runtime tool-notes source and Doctor as the one-time migration owner.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged attestation work and this follow-on PR place this contributor closest to the intended migration contract and its rationale.
